decisions: CSharp InferContextualValue gives array literals the parameter element context before argument checking. Reuse SLG contextual record-field value resolution with interned literal storage/length, so element/range diagnostics keep authority instead of adding exceptions to argument mismatch diagnosis. Stored/explicit typed arrays retain identity.

CSharp runtime additional-argument count checks use call/target origin; generic helpers keep existing declaration origin. Carry a provenance-checked canonical Command.collect/runToFile identity and target AST in the arity diagnostic; reuse canonical call path renderer.

CSharp direct qualified calls count all explicit runtime arguments. SLG direct arity must admit resolved imported and qualified static calls, while existing dotted local receiver handling keeps supplying self.
Use existing calls.displayFunctionSymbol with standard-library source range for formatter contracts, rather than a parallel namespace/name classifier.
CSharp compiler source is unchanged from M11177; all strict managed proofs remain current. SLG source changed, so V11195 proofs are retained at their real epoch and a new build is required.
